layers.title: MOVA red core
layers.description: Constitutional core of MOVA language: vendor-neutral ds/env/global contracts, verbs/actions, and episode semantics. No runtime implementation or domain package layout.

layers.title: MOVA contracts layer
layers.description: Domain/process contracts built on MOVA language primitives. Full contract/package canon is defined in mova-contract-spec.

layers.title: Infrastructure and vendor bindings
layers.description: Runtime and connector bindings to concrete platforms. Infra executes contracts but does not redefine MOVA language semantics.

layers.title: Applications and UX
layers.description: User-facing products, consoles, and developer tools that consume MOVA contracts through envelopes and APIs.

namespace_rules.description: Red core ds.* schemas use reserved domains mova, mova4, security, runtime_core, connector_core.

namespace_rules.pattern_hint: ds.<domain>_* where <domain> is not one of the reserved red_core domains.
namespace_rules.description: Contracts use domain prefixes and must not reuse red_core prefixes.
Vendor-specific connector descriptions live in infra and follow ds.connector_<vendor>_* pattern.
Runtime bindings extend the core runtime contract in the infra layer.

migration.reason: MOVA canonical layer vocabulary uses contracts. External skill ecosystems may map to contracts for compatibility.

meta.note: MOVA 7.0.0 layered model. v2 supersedes v1 and keeps red_core and infra boundaries while replacing skills terminology with contracts.
